description: Walt Disney World restaurants ranked by how rarely a reservation opens, from SupaPark's own availability checks: difficulty tier, the share of checks that found a table, and cancellations ("drops") caught in the last 30 days. Disneyland Resort parks (disneyland, california-adventure) are accepted; they return quality_state "unavailable" until Disneyland Resort data is connected.

park.description: Filter to restaurants in this park.

resort.description: Resort: "wdw" (Walt Disney World, the default) or "dlr" (Disneyland Resort). A park argument, when given, decides the resort.

name: get_hardest_dining_reservations
title: Hardest dining reservations
